# POSE v0.17.0

## Added

- Agents can now verify which MCP server process and project registry they are actually connected to through the policy-filtered `pose_mcp_context` tool, which never exposes filesystem roots. `pose doctor` now states explicitly that it only inspects static configuration, and unknown project selections return structured reconnect remediation. Community feedback submissions use the repository's standard issue labels. (pose-mcp-active-context)
